result.instructions: Tools for webinar.net, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our webinars are scheduled for next week, and when does each one start?"; "How many people registered for our last webinar, and how many attended live?"; "Show the registration form fields of our product demo webinar.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes webinar.net data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run webinarnet_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run webinarnet_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run webinarnet_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. webinarnet_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: webinarnet_list_webinars
tools.title: List webinars
tools.description: List the webinars in the account, one page at a time, with title, language, screen-sharing and green-room settings, and the latest schedule. Good first call to find a webinar id. webinar.net Open API: GET /webinars.

fields.description: Extra data to include, as the API names it (for example: schedules).

tools.name: webinarnet_get_webinar
tools.title: Get a webinar
tools.description: Get one webinar by id: title, language, source, URLs and the latest schedule. webinar.net Open API: GET /webinars/{webinarId}.

tools.name: webinarnet_get_webinar_summary
tools.title: Get a webinar summary
tools.description: Get the summary of one webinar: title, folders, start date, duration, and the registrant, live attendee, on-demand attendee and no-show counts. webinar.net Open API: GET /webinars/{webinarId}/summary.

tools.name: webinarnet_list_schedules
tools.title: List webinar schedules
tools.description: List the schedules (session dates and times) of one webinar, with their type, status and time zone. webinar.net Open API: GET /webinars/{webinarId}/schedules.

tools.name: webinarnet_get_schedule
tools.title: Get a webinar schedule
tools.description: Get one schedule of a webinar: start, end, time zone and status. webinar.net Open API: GET /webinars/{webinarId}/schedules/{scheduleId}.

tools.name: webinarnet_get_registration_form_fields
tools.title: Get registration form fields
tools.description: List the registration form fields of one webinar: key, label, type, order and whether each field is required. Call this before webinarnet_create_registrant to get the right keys. webinar.net Open API: GET /webinars/{webinarId}/registration-form/fields.

tools.name: webinarnet_list_registrants
tools.title: List webinar registrants
tools.description: List the registrants of one webinar, one page at a time, with their registration fields, source and date. Personal data: only read what the task needs. webinar.net Open API: GET /webinars/{webinarId}/registrants.

tools.name: webinarnet_get_registrant
tools.title: Get a webinar registrant
tools.description: Get one registrant of a webinar by id, with the registration fields and the registration date. Personal data. webinar.net Open API: GET /webinars/{webinarId}/registrants/{registrantId}.

tools.name: webinarnet_list_attendees
tools.title: List webinar attendees
tools.description: List the attendees of one webinar, one page at a time: live and on-demand attendance flags, join dates and watch durations, and optionally each attendee's activities. Personal data: only read what the task needs. webinar.net Open API: GET /webinars/{webinarId}/attendees.

includeActivities.description: true = include each attendee's activities (larger reply).

tools.name: webinarnet_create_registrant
tools.title: Register a person for a webinar
tools.description: Add a registrant to a webinar. This creates a real registration on the webinar. Get the field keys with webinarnet_get_registration_form_fields first. Not idempotent: a second call creates a second registrant. webinar.net Open API: POST /webinars/{webinarId}/registrants.

value.description: The value. For a drop-down or radio field, use one of the option labels.

fields.description: The registration answers, one { key, value } per form field.

annotations.title: Register a person for a webinar

tools.name: webinarnet_update_registrant
tools.title: Update a webinar registrant
tools.description: Change the registration answers of one registrant. Send the fields to change, with their keys from webinarnet_get_registration_form_fields. Repeating the same call gives the same result. webinar.net Open API: PUT /webinars/{webinarId}/registrants/{registrantId}.

value.description: The value. For a drop-down or radio field, use one of the option labels.

fields.description: The registration answers, one { key, value } per form field.
